content:
Just ahead of its big iPhone reveal event, Apple has just rolled out a brand new iOS 26.6.2 software update for iPhone. Here's what this update includes.

iOS 26.6.2 fixes an issue that prevented users from being able to update their software over a cellular connection

Apple is expected to release iOS 27 very soon, likely as early as next week.

But before that major release, Apple has delivered a smaller iOS 26.6.2 update today.

You can install iOS 26.6.2 on your iPhone via the Software Update screen in Settings.

Below is Apple's official update notes:

Given the bug fixes introduced in this update, releasing iOS 26.6.2 on the eve of the expected iOS 27 announcement makes a lot of sense.

If iOS 26.6.1 prevented users from installing iOS 27 over a cellular connection, next week could have been a headache for both Apple and its users.

But by rolling out this update now, many iPhones will get the needed fix before installing the much-anticipated iOS 27.

So while this release itself isn't particularly exciting, it's a timely update for the upcoming iOS 27 and all of the new features it brings.

In addition to iOS 26.6.2, Apple has also released iPadOS 26.6.2 for iPad with the exact same bug fix.

Have you installed iOS 26.6.2 yet? Notice any other changes? Let us know in the comments.
